mechanism: Amitriptyline increases skin photosensitivity and adapalene causes retinoid-induced irritation and photosensitivity, compounding dermatologic adverse effects and increasing risk of severe phototoxicity.
action: Advise patients to use high SPF sunscreen, protective clothing, and minimize sun exposure during concurrent use; monitor for excessive skin irritation and consider alternative antidepressant if severe dermatologic reactions develop.
